name: Reward-pool progression
summary: A reward pool changes as items are discovered so repeated completion can guarantee breadth before returning to unrestricted chance.
player_action: The player repeatedly completes an activity seeking distinct rewards.
system_response: Undiscovered rewards receive bounded priority until the declared set is unlocked, after which normal drop rules resume.

conflicts_with: unbounded duplicate chance before baseline completion

failure_modes: The pool cannot state what completion means.
Knockout state diverges from owned rewards.
Later pool changes silently invalidate completion.
Guaranteed breadth removes every long-term chase.
accessibility: Expose discovered and remaining categories without requiring external tools.
Distinguish guaranteed progression from random chance.

smallest_playable_test.setup: A six-item pool with duplicates, three simulated profiles, save/reload, and a post-completion phase.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Every profile reaches declared breadth without state disagreement and post-completion rewards remain meaningful.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: Breadth succeeds but anticipation collapses or the final item feels mechanically predetermined too early.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: Players can complete the activity repeatedly without measurable pool progress under the declared guarantee.

evidence.claim: Bungie documented Nightfall rewards using a knockout list until all weapons are unlocked, then returning to flat drop chances.
evidence.game_version: Destiny 2 Edge of Fate reward changes
